propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer: differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes expects jira_key in local_state entries, but run_differs passes fetched Jira snapshots which never carry jira_key, so the chain is dead in production.

Deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination is already implemented twice and live: outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py perform bounded direct GETs, verified on real DC, making the absent inbound-probe arm architecturally redundant.

The operator ruling forbids resurrection of deliberately-deleted Jira issues: a confirmed-deleted binding must not re-create the issue, requiring a tombstone guard on the unbound-create path to prevent eventual resurrection.
BindingStore.is_retired_local(local_id) and unretire(jira_key) must be added to enforce the tombstone and provide a documented escape hatch, with a bridge alert naming the remedy.

The dead legacy arm (_compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes, _run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch, route_inbound_probe, _apply_inbound_delete, create_after_hard_delete) must be removed, not orphaned, and all consumer modules updated.
